ammonia.reason: Amino acid/urea deamination by smear yeasts and Brevibacterium raising rind pH 4.5 to 6.5

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol, indole and isovaleric/propionic acids from Brevibacterium proteolysis and Marc wash

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from chymosin and Brevibacterium proteinases during 28d ripening

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti, no C7/C9 methyl-ketone blue-mold pathway

browning.reason: Maillard between proteolysis peptides and residual lactose/galactose on heating

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation by Lactococcus, partly masked by wash

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic 2340 ppm plus 3-methylbutanoic 430 ppm from lipolysis and Leu catabolism

creaminess.reason: 26% fat, 56.67% FDM with proteolyzed smooth oozing paste

crumbliness.reason: High-moisture 54.12% deacidified paste flows, no dry fracture

firmness.reason: Unpressed lactic curd, high moisture ripened to spoonable soft body

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/octanoate and 2-phenylethyl acetate ++++ esterification with Marc ethanol

goaty.reason: Cow milk with no 4-methyl/4-ethyl-octanoic acids, hexanoic only 160 ppm

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal from Leu/Ile by smear coryneforms at low level

melt.reason: pH 6.01 deacidified hydrated casein flows readily when heated

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation, minor versus smear sulfur

oil_off.reason: Free oil coalescence from 26% lipolyzed fat on heating

smoky.reason: No smoking and no guaiacol, only trace Marc brandy congeners

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic 1760 ppm plus propanoic 1490 ppm partly neutralized by rind deacidification

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata stretching, short lactic curd with no aligned casein

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methanethiol to dimethyl disulfide from Met catabolism by Brevibacterium linens

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted by >16h lactic fermentation, slight glycerol/ester sweetness

umami.reason: Glutamate release from extensive rennet and smear proteolysis of 19.49% protein
